blocks.orig: This full-day excursion to the Nakupenda sandbank is an excursion to love! Nakupenda means I love you in Swahili, and the moment you set foot on this sandbank, you will be infatuated with this little island in the middle of the ocean. Go swimming, walk along the shoreline, enjoy the beautiful views and the fresh seafood BBQ for lunch which is included.
blocks.html: You’ll love this full-day trip to the Nakupenda sandbank! In Swahili, Nakupenda means I love you, and as soon as you step onto the sand you’ll fall for this little island in the middle of the sea. Swim, stroll along the water’s edge, take in the lovely views and enjoy the fresh seafood BBQ lunch that’s included.
